reuse.why: Uses findOrCreateBank, syncAccount, handleSyncResponse and getServer, and extracts clearAccountBankLink so the takeover and unlinkAccount share one reset; but the Fintegra link/download are written by copying the Akahu ones rather than sharing them.

duplication.why: linkFintegraAccount is a near-verbatim copy of linkAkahuAccount and downloadFintegraTransactions a copy of downloadAkahuTransactions, following the tree's per-provider copy pattern; the link guard itself is shared.

placement.why: Provider plumbing lands in server-config, sync.ts and accounts/app.ts as for other providers; the closed-account check is folded into a helper named for the duplicate-link rule.

scope.why: All edits serve the four steps: duplicate-link guard, Fintegra provider, closed-account refusal and takeover flag.

maintainability.why: One guard called at the top of every link function and a shared unlink reset are easy to own, though the guard's name hides the closed-account rule and the new provider adds another copy to keep in sync.

bypasses_abstraction.where: none; every provider link function calls assertBankAccountNotLinked and unlinkAccount uses clearAccountBankLink

disguised_duplication.where: the Fintegra link and download copies are plain copies of the Akahu ones, not disguised

abstraction_drift.where: assertBankAccountNotLinked gains replaceExistingLink and absorbs an unrelated closed-account branch for upgradingId
